verdicts.reason: Both candidates crop the background in so far that the white 'Lima & Co Group' wordmark now sits on top of the white circle and the busy gold halftone. That breaks the original layout, where the text sat in a clean navy circle. In both, 'Lima &' and 'Group' mostly vanish and only 'Co' reads against the navy. A is slightly less bad because its heavier, larger type keeps a few more letters legible. B's thinner, smaller type leaves 'Group' close to invisible and 'Co' clipped against the white circle.
